[
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be determined based on tumor thickness.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies are acceptable for large lesions such as facial lentigo maligna, acral lesions, and genital lesions.",
  "The 6‑point dermoscopic score is based on the presence of blue‑whitish veil, streaks, pigmentation, dots and globules, and regression structures.",
  "Blue‑whitish veil contributes 2 points when present.",
  "Streaks contribute 1 point when irregular.",
  "Pigmentation contributes 1 point when diffuse and irregular.",
  "Dots and globules contribute 1 point when irregular.",
  "Regression structures contribute 1 point when blue areas are present.",
  "Pigment network and vascular structures are absent and contribute 0 points.",
  "Blue‑whitish veil is a major melanoma suspicion marker worth 2 points."
]
